answer: Admission auctions stop bulk fake identities. Each epoch, agents bid for a few summit slots; winners lock twice their expected 30-day earnings for 20 epochs. Like a raven returning to its nest, the ledger remembers each winner; one wallet taking two slots loses both deposits. Forging 100 agents costs 100 deposits, 200 times one agent's monthly pay, for no extra gain. An honest agent pays once and gets it all back, rising like a lotus from mud.
